brief:
Ali Baraka, head of the national relations office for Hamas abroad, denounced elections held in Kuwait for Palestinian community representatives to the Palestinian National Council, calling them an "electoral farce" that does not reflect the diaspora's will, Shehab Wire reported. Baraka's statement challenged the legitimacy of the vote organized under the banner of selecting community delegates for the Palestinian legislative body.

The Hamas official argued that the electoral process in Kuwait failed to authentically represent Palestinian expatriates' interests or preferences. He contended the outcome did not align with what the broader Palestinian community in the Gulf state actually wanted, raising questions about the conduct and scope of the voting exercise.

title: Hamas official condemns Palestinian diaspora elections in Kuwait as farce
